start: Profile tab, Progress, 'Your lifts' list, member with logged workouts

steps.action: Tap the row 'Any exercise' under Your lifts
user_sees: Subtitle 'See its trend on your Profile'
Search box 'Search exercises' and the exercise list, recent first
must_not: 'No exercises found' shown while the list is still loading

steps.action: Type 'bench' and tap 'Show trend' on Bench Press
user_sees: The app goes back to Profile
Your lifts shows Bench Press and its trend chart
must_not: The row picked earlier still shown instead of Bench Press
A second screen opened or the app going back past Profile

steps.action: Use the muscle and gear filters instead of typing, then tap 'Show trend' on an exercise
user_sees: Only exercises of that muscle and gear listed
must_not: The filter choice opening a different exercise's trend

steps.action: Type a name that matches nothing, like 'zzzz'
user_sees: 'Try a different search, muscle or gear.'
must_not: A 'Create' offer (this list cannot make an exercise)
A crash or an endless spinner

user_sees: Profile, with the lift that was shown before
must_not: The lift shown before replaced by nothing

start: Profile tab, Your lifts showing a lift picked from Any exercise

steps.action: Tap another lift row in Your lifts, then open Any exercise and pick the first lift again
user_sees: The first lift's trend comes back
must_not: The second pick of the same exercise ignored

steps.action: Close the app and open Profile again
user_sees: Your lifts opens on the most-trained lift (the pick is not kept)
must_not: An error or an empty chart because the picked lift is gone
